summary: Use the two-column legend as ordered color substitutions and recolor every non-background target pixel outside the legend.
src: non-background pixels outside the unique fully filled two-column legend
transform: replace each target pixel color with the final color reached by the ordered substitutions; keep the legend and background unchanged
symbol_instructions: the two-column legend maps each row's left color to that row's right color
multi_step: for each target pixel, scan legend rows top-to-bottom while carrying the current color, so later rows can rewrite earlier substitution results
